messages:
maria-docs: Quick sync — we need a concise migration checklist for v1->v2 and a low-cost CI smoke job to catch docs + SDK snippet regressions.

sam-sdk: I can sweep SDK and samples for client.v1 and old embed aliases. Will open PRs to replace with v2 patterns and add a CHANGELOG note.

eli-qa: Proposing CI job docs/snippet-quick that runs 3 minimal snippets (py, js, go). It should assert exit code, verify embedding dims for rwd-embed-128/1536, and validate streaming signature. Save logs to artifacts/docs/snippet-quick/1749999001.

noah-web: Web team will stage a redirect rule: /v1/* -> /docs/migrate-v2 (302) for 45 days, then 301. Filing WEB-9407 and will attach ticket to the docs PR.

ci-bot: CI job docs/snippet-quick scheduled by @eli-qa

eli-qa: Run finished: 2/3 snippets passed. JS streaming example failed due to old `onmessage` callback signature. Log: artifacts/docs/snippet-quick/1749999001/js-stream-fail.log

maria-docs: Thanks. I'll push a focused docs PR updating the JS streaming example and add a one-line migration note mapping old->new callback.

sam-sdk: I'll follow with sample app PRs and emit a console.warn in the v1 shim with the retirement date to surface to devs.

maria-docs: Draft banner copy: "Redwood API v1 will be retired 2026-05-15. Please migrate to v2: /docs/migrate-v2. Contact support for enterprise migrations." Short and linked.

noah-web: Redirect ticket WEB-9407 is ready to stage after PRs merge.

eli-qa: Once PRs are merged I'll rerun the CI smoke job and post the final artifacts.

maria-docs: Owners: docs @maria-docs, SDK @sam-sdk, CI @eli-qa, web @noah-web. Target: fixes merged by EOD Fri, announcement next Mon. Thanks all :rocket:
